$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — CV-5 (CE-2237) fear spreads through a crowd. A DEMO by size (17 units, so no golden). From the header's Judge (0)-(3): the rifleman opens fire (the take's first round at 1.1 s), >= 5 civilians hear it (CivilianState.HeardAt > 0), >= 4 never hear anything, and fear reaches the deaf: Civilians 10-15 are 94-142 m out, so >= 3 of '*Civilian 1' (Civilian 1 plus 10-15, the one near man included) frightened is the necessary form of 'at least 3 deaf ones panic' (a field cue cannot AND 'never heard' with 'frightened' on one man). 'ONE crowd' is CrowdId != 0 for all fifteen (equal ids cannot be compared across units).

expect.name: they stand in a crowd (every civilian has a CrowdId)
at least three of the far end are frightened (caught from the crowd)
at least four never hear anything
